title: Public Service exposure
message: Service type LoadBalancer may create public ingress; network policies and cloud ACLs are not validated
requirement: Confirm intended audience; prefer ClusterIP behind a reviewed Ingress; verify firewall/ACLs.

title: Secret-like literal in env
message: Env var DB_PASSWORD has an inline literal value (value withheld)
requirement: Use valueFrom.secretKeyRef or an external secret store; rotate the exposed value.

title: Resource removed from desired state
message: ConfigMap/demo/legacy-flags exists BEFORE but not AFTER
requirement: Confirm deletion is intended and data is backed up
